name: cwi_sync_availability
description: Check sync/licensing availability for a catalog track (CWI Sync & Licensing). Reads the One-Stop grant contract terms and the Syncdeck cue cards. HONEST TIERS: creator-tier ($0) grants are issuable; indie/commercial tiers are DRAFT templates pending the owner's exact-terms approval — never present draft tiers as issuable. Business contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com. This tool drafts nothing and signs nothing.

use_type.description: Requested tier. Only 'creator' is issuable; indie/commercial are draft-pending-owner-approval.

project_description.description: Short description of the sync use (game, film, ad, etc.).
